## About
Prime Time Sports Grill is a family owned and operated sports grill on N Dale Mabry Hwy in Tampa. We like to think of it as Carrollwood's favorite place to watch the game, eat well and hang out.
There are TVs everywhere you look, craft beer and NTN trivia when you want something to do between plays. One first-time guest said the place was so much bigger than they expected, with lots of space to entertain.
We're rated 4.4 on Google from 1215 reviews. Come by, pull up a seat and hang out with us.

## Services
- Craft beer: Craft beer and cold brew to go with the game.
- NTN trivia: Play NTN trivia while you eat and drink.
- Wings: One reviewer ordered medium wings and found them a little hotter than expected, but so yummy.
- Early bird burger: One reviewer had the early bird burger and says she'll definitely be back.

## FAQ
Q: Can I bring the kids?
A: Yes. We're a family friendly sports grill.

Q: Can I hear the game from my table?
A: Yes. There are individual speakers at each table.

Q: Is it a good spot for a group?
A: Sure. One reviewer put it this way: bring your crew over, or just grab a chair at the bar and enjoy. It can get crowded and noisy sometimes.

## What customers say
- "1st time here; the place was so much bigger than we anticipated. Lots of TVs, games and space to entertain. I’m positive this place is happening during football!

The food was very good! Portions were on point! Wings ordered were medium, a little hotter than expected but so yummy we were told. The burger was cooked perfectly. The salad was a very good size.

Only downside was we weren’t checked on at all until after the meals were half eaten to being completely finished,  we all had to wait on drink refills." (Elle Lee, 5/5)
- "Met my family for dinner, it was exceptional. Angie was our server and her service was amazing, I had the early bird burger and I will definitely be back at least once a week. The food is delicious and the staff is very welcoming and makes you feel special 💖" (MARILYN MENENDEZ ARNETT (MmenenA), 5/5)
